{
  "name": "last-call",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "Stops work at a clean point before the 5-hour (or 7-day) usage limit, keeps the prompt cache warm while waiting, and continues the work after the reset.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Sunkanxx"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "autoResume": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Resume automatically",
      "description": "Continue the work by itself after the reset. Off: wait for /last-call go or your next prompt.",
      "default": true
    },
    "wrapAtPercent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "5-hour wrap-up at (%)",
      "description": "The 5-hour fill at which the model is told to find a clean stopping point.",
      "options": [
        "70",
        "80",
        "85",
        "90",
        "95"
      ],
      "default": "90"
    },
    "stopAtPercent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "5-hour stop at (%)",
      "description": "The 5-hour fill at which every tool but writing the handoff note is refused. The rest is the keep-alive reserve.",
      "options": [
        "85",
        "90",
        "95",
        "98",
        "100"
      ],
      "default": "95"
    },
    "sevenDayWrapAtPercent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "7-day wrap-up at (%)",
      "description": "The 7-day fill at which the model is told to find a clean stopping point.",
      "options": [
        "70",
        "80",
        "85",
        "90",
        "95"
      ],
      "default": "90"
    },
    "sevenDayStopPercent": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "7-day stop at (%)",
      "description": "The 7-day fill at which work stops.",
      "options": [
        "85",
        "90",
        "95",
        "98",
        "100"
      ],
      "default": "95"
    },
    "wrapLeadMinutes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Wrap-up lead (minutes)",
      "description": "Also start wrapping up when the burn rate projects the stop within this many minutes.",
      "options": [
        "0",
        "5",
        "10",
        "15",
        "20",
        "30"
      ],
      "default": "10"
    },
    "keepAlive": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Keep the cache warm",
      "description": "While paused, ping the same model with the cached conversation, but only when that costs less than reloading it once.",
      "default": true
    },
    "keepAliveMinutes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Keep-alive interval (minutes)",
      "description": "Minutes between keep-alive pings (the cache lives 60 minutes).",
      "options": [
        "15",
        "30",
        "45",
        "50",
        "55"
      ],
      "default": "55"
    },
    "keepAliveSessions": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Keep-alive sessions",
      "description": "all: every paused session pings its own cache. one: only one session on this machine pings at a time.",
      "options": [
        "all",
        "one"
      ],
      "default": "all"
    },
    "handoffPath": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Handoff note path",
      "description": "Where the model writes the handoff note, relative to the project root. Must stay inside the project.",
      "default": ".claude/last-call/handoff.md"
    },
    "handoffGitIgnored": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Git-ignore the handoff note",
      "description": "Add the note's path to the repository's local exclude file (.git/info/exclude). No tracked file is changed.",
      "default": true
    },
    "coldResumeDefault": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cold resume default",
      "description": "When the cache has expired at resume and nobody answers: compact then resume, resume with the full context, or wait.",
      "options": [
        "compact",
        "full",
        "wait"
      ],
      "default": "compact"
    },
    "coldResumeTimeoutMinutes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cold resume timeout (minutes)",
      "description": "How long the cold-resume question waits for an answer before the default applies.",
      "options": [
        "1",
        "5",
        "10",
        "15",
        "30",
        "60"
      ],
      "default": "10"
    }
  }
}
